CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   C. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   D. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   B. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   D. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   C. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.
   B. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   C. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

12. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.
   D. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Parable of the Lost Sheep and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Rich Young Ruler 3 3.9 A Friend at Midnight 3 Page 12 of 87 xii 4.0 The Chur and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Rich Young Man and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain A friend at Midnight and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
